This '''lightsaber''' was used by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Neebo/Legends|Neebo]]. After Neebo went missing on a mission to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]], the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was found in the collection of the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
